from.name: Linux TCP_INFO / struct tcp_info observability ABI

property: The stable TCP_INFO socket-option ABI is extended append-style with pacing-rate fields so monitoring applications such as ss can expose a newer control variable without replacing the older per-connection metrics structure.

date_or_range.notes: Exact original TCP_INFO introduction patch is pre-git and remains open.

negative_claims: Pacing rate is not a TCP wire-header field.
Adding new fields did not create a new TCP protocol version.
open_questions: Recover exact pre-git TCP_INFO introduction and all intervening field-add commits.
